as_told.title: Pax River facility for the planned Lockheed Martin to Bigelow transfer
as_told.place_text: Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland

plain: A congressman named Eric Burlison says that in 2025 he stood on site at Naval Air Station Patuxent River in Maryland, known as Pax River, and saw the facility that was meant to receive a transfer from the defense company Lockheed Martin to Bigelow Aerospace, a company owned by a businessman named Robert Bigelow. If true, it would point to some hidden holding passing from one company to another. Burlison tells it first-hand on the show, Michels later repeats him as saying that if a craft were stored anywhere it would be at Pax River, and a Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown adds that Burlison got a tour but was shown nothing resembling technology of unknown origin.
